Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane illusion spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus spells from high Intelligence.
  • Int 13–15 = +1 extra 1st level spell; Int 16–17 = +1 extra 2nd level spell; Int 18 = +1 extra 3rd level spell

Minor Figment

  • Effect: At-will, as your action, create a harmless, momentary visual or sound distraction within 30ft — no save, no mechanical effect beyond what the GM rules, but usable to feint, mask a small sound or object, or grant advantage on a single Stealth check per encounter.

Disguise (Charisma)

  • Effect: Disguise self or impersonate others — 1d3×10 minutes of preparation for a general disguise, 1 month for a specific individual. Apparent height/weight change is limited to one-tenth of the original.
  • The GM rolls secretly. The more your disguise differs from your own build, age and ancestry, and the more suspicious the observer, the harder the check.
  • Arcane spells like Change Self can augment the check

Sharp Senses

  • Effect: +1 bonus to all saves vs illusion spells and effects. The innate ability to distinguish the real from the unreal sharpens over time.
  • Improves to +2 at 4th, +3 at 7th, +4 at 10th, +5 at 13th, +6 at 16th

Master of Illusion

  • Effect: The save DC of your Illusion spells is increased by 1, rising to +2 at 12th level.

2nd Level

Lingering Illusion

  • Effect: An illusion you maintain by concentration lasts 1 more round after you stop concentrating or are interrupted.

3rd Level

Convincing Illusions

  • Effect: A creature makes its first save to disbelieve each of your illusions with Disadvantage. Always on.

4th Level

Quickened Illusion

  • Effect: Once per day, cast an Illusion-school spell of 2nd level or lower as part of the same action as another spell.

5th Level

Convincing Detail

  • Effect: Creatures that only study your illusion, without touching or interacting with it, get no save to disbelieve it. Always on.

6th Level

See Invisible (Intelligence)

  • Effect: Make an Intelligence check to perceive invisible objects or creatures — does not fully reveal them, only their general location and movement. Make the check once per round, as no action, while an invisible creature or object is within 30ft.
  • From 18th level: after a successful check, can now determine the shape and size of the invisible target

7th Level

Detect Magic (Intelligence)

  • Effect: After 5 rounds of study and concentration, determine whether an item is magical. A successful Intelligence check reveals the magic's origin (Aldorethi craft, divine creation, alchemy, etc.) — requires having previously encountered that type of magic.
  • From 18th level: also reveals the item's relative power (great or small) and its importance to a people, culture, or historical entity

8th Level

Enduring Illusion

  • Effect: An Illusion spell of yours that needs no concentration lasts twice as long.

10th Level

Change Self

  • Effect: Once per day, alter own appearance, racial features, smell, sound, and tactile sensations. Unlike the spell, the duration is permanent until dispelled by the illusionist.

15th Level

  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence

24th Level

See Invisible (Permanent)

  • Effect: The illusionist's ability to pierce the real and unreal reaches supernatural levels — permanently see all things as per the True Seeing spell with no check required.

Magnum Opus

  • Effect: Once per month, perform a day-long ritual combining Distort Reality, Hallucinatory Terrain, Permanent Image, Polymorph Any Object, and Spectral Force to create any single object, being, or 10ft×10ft/level area.
  • Beings created can be of Level up to half the illusionist's level with all appropriate creature powers
  • The effect cannot be dispelled for 1 day per caster level (except by a spellcaster of equal or greater level)
  • There is a 1% chance per illusionist level that the creation becomes permanently real — at which point it cannot be dispelled or disbelieved, ever
  • Only one Magnum Opus can exist at a time (unless it has become real)

Kits: Arneyan Illusion Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Illusionist folder. Drag one onto your character.

Illusionist Kits represent the tradition, school, or circumstance that trained the character in the arcane arts of illusion.

Illusionist Spell List

Spells available to the Illusionist, by level. * = reversible spell. ‡ = needs a costed material component (see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue). Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.

Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Intelligence 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the Illusionist is high enough level to cast that tier.
